title: Randomium Skyblock
description: A faithful recreation of Torchy's challenge: Minecraft Skyblock, but EVERY single block broken and mob killed drops a completely random item!
body:
Skyblock But ALL Drops Are Random (Torchy Remake)
Inspired by the popular video by YouTuber Torchy, this mod brings the ultimate chaos challenge to your Minecraft world! Created due to high demand, you can now experience the exact same grind and madness yourself.

Key Features:
100% Randomized Drops: Every block you manually break and every mob you kill drops a random item from the entire game (1,600+ possibilities).

Vanilla Rules Apply: Blocks that break naturally (like decaying leaves) still drop their normal items—your only lifeline for saplings!

Custom Progress & Multipliers: Discover rare custom drops (Randinium) to craft overpowered tools and stackable enchantments (up to 16x drops with Fortune/Looting) to conquer the randomness.

The Goal: Defeat the Ender Dragon despite the pure RNG.

Original concept by Torchy. Download now and see if you can beat the odds!

**Dependencies:
Fabric API**

Latest Update:
Added a Challenges Menu / UI, accessible via a keybind (default: J)
